subject: What's new in A Fish in the Kitchen 1.12
heading: What's new
paragraphs: A short note from me — three things changed in the app this week.
Scan a recipe. Point the camera at a handwritten card or a cookbook page and it types itself. It's the first thing you see now.
Who's cooking with you? Inviting your family is one tap, right after you create a cookbook — and you'll hear when they add something.
Notifications, your way. Under More → Notifications you can choose exactly what you hear about.

What should we do next? Reply to this email — it comes straight to me.
— Dylan
